description: This file is a shell script for testing the fsck (file system consistency check) functionality on buffers without NUL termination, involving git object parsing and validation.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the test environment by creating an empty base file.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a line with specified content to the base file, indicating object type.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a test to verify that a truncated or malformed object causes the expected failure and error message.

methods.name: ident_checks
methods.description: Performs a series of validation checks on commit or tag objects for missing or malformed fields.
